title: AES-128 Attack Faster Than Exhaustive Search
summary: No AES-128 attack faster than exhaustive search was known; the open task is to determine whether one exists and construct it.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether there exists an attack on $\mathrm{AES}\text{-}128$ that is faster than exhaustive search and, if so, construct such an attack.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptanalysis of the AES-128 block cipher.
parameters: 128-bit AES key size: identifies the target variant and determines the exhaustive-search baseline
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether any attack on AES-128 is faster than exhaustive search and, if so, how to construct one.

citations.label: Key Recovery Attacks of Practical Complexity on AES-256 Variants with up to 10 Rounds

progress.summary: The paper explicitly lists this question among its open problems, noting that its attacks do not apply to AES-128 and that no faster-than-exhaustive attack was known.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Key Recovery Attacks of Practical Complexity on AES-256 Variants with up to 10 Rounds
